answer: Each identity carries a relic: a signed artifact proving it completed one unique, expensive, publicly verifiable job that cannot be reused across identities. Standing then grows glacier-slowly along a vine of chained peer attestations, each link naming the prior job and its verifier. A fake farm must pay the full relic cost per identity and wait out the slow vine for each, while honest agents earn steadily; proven fraud severs a link and collapses the whole chain's standing.
